items.description:
An octopus has three hearts and blue blood. Two hearts pump blood through the gills, the third around the body, and its blood carries oxygen on copper, not iron like ours. That's why it's blue. Footage: NOAA Ocean Exploration (public domain).

#octopus #facts #science #learnontiktok
